note: Level 1, both label levels read (.sav copied from the batch_660 wallace_2026_s2_like cache; sha256 matches; the Study 2 .sps contains no perf text). CODE DERIVATION: SINGLE spec s2_perf.csv = (s2, perf{i} -> perf{i}, i = 1,2,3), rev flag 0 for all three, no flip, so item IS the source column name: exempt from Step 5b, no verification files. Study 2 only (live has no cov_study, no itemcov_recoded and no itemcov_reverse_keyed column). Variable labels: perf1 = I think I would get a good grade in this class., perf2 = I think I would do quite well in this class., perf3 = I am not confident in my ability to do well in a course taught by the professor. -- shipped verbatim, unprefixed (single study); the this class / a course taught by the professor wording difference is the source's own. OPTIONS: all three items value-labelled 1=1 - Strongly agree, 2..6 bare digits, 7=7 - Strongly disagree; shipped Strongly agree / Strongly disagree with the number prefixes stripped (sibling convention), 2-6 blank, not padded. Sanity counts (not required for the exemption): source 838 rows, 838 non-missing on each item; live 2514 rows = 838 ids x 3; item resp-count vectors source = live exactly: perf1 124/163/124/180/131/74/42, perf2 128/140/138/178/130/82/42, perf3 75/89/121/132/156/134/131; every item used all 7 levels. Direction cross-check: perf1-2 mean correlates -0.47 with the Study 2 interest mean (interest1-3, 1 = not at all ... 7 = extremely) and +0.51 with the engage1-2 mean (1 = Strongly agree); r(perf1, perf2) = +0.93, so the printed 1 = Strongly agree direction is consistent with the data. REVERSE WORDING: perf3 is negatively worded and is stored AS DEPOSITED, not reversed: r(perf3, perf1) = r(perf3, perf2) = -0.51, and perf3 correlates +0.44 with interest and -0.32 with engage (opposite signs to perf1-2). The build script does not flip it and the table carries no itemcov_reverse_keyed flag; disclosed in public_note. No instructions or lead-in text in the .sav or .sps; instructions left blank. Dictionary Description: Expected performance. Rights: study-authored items; no fee, permission, NC or redistribution clause located (silence = permission). Not in instrument_rights_register.csv; no register row written.
public_note: Responses run 1 = Strongly agree to 7 = Strongly disagree, so a higher value means less agreement; perf3 is negatively worded (not confident of doing well) and is stored as answered, not reverse-scored, so it runs opposite to perf1 and perf2 (r = -0.51).
